sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) Parliament may enact a law providing for— (a) the establishment of a Contingencies Fund and authorizing the President or a Minister appointed by the President in that behalf to make advances from that Fund for the purpose of meeting urgent and unforeseen expenditure for which no provision has been made; and (b) authorizing the President or the Minister appointed by the President in that behalf to apply money specifically appropriated for some other purpose to meet urgent and unforeseen expenditure of the kind referred to in paragraph (a) of this subarticle. (2) Where any advance is made from the Contingencies Fund or any money specifically appropriated for another purpose is applied to meet urgent and unforeseen expenditure, supplementary estimates shall be submitted to the National Assembly and, when the supplementary estimates have been approved by the National Assembly, the Appropriation Bill introduced for the purpose of authorizing such supplementary expenditure shall make provision for the repayment into the Contingencies Fund of any amount advanced from that Fund.
